hasDefinedTerm.description: An electronic record, not a physical certificate, that a licensed sponsor assigns to a worker they wish to employ. The worker uses its reference number to apply for their visa.

hasDefinedTerm.description: A fine issued to an employer who is found to have employed someone without the right to work in the UK. Penalties are set per worker and increase for repeat breaches.

hasDefinedTerm.description: A check carried out by the Home Office to confirm a sponsor is meeting its duties. It can be announced or unannounced, and may happen before or after a licence is granted.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Immigration Advice Authority (IAA)

hasDefinedTerm.description: Also called settlement. It allows a person to live and work in the UK without time restrictions, and is usually a step towards British citizenship.

hasDefinedTerm.description: A code that classifies a job role. It is used to check whether a role is eligible for sponsorship and what the going rate for the role is.
